name: pgpanel-frontend
description: Build-time Tailwind CSS and vendored JS for PgPanel (Node is not required at runtime)

scripts.build:js: mkdir -p static/js && cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js static/js/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js static/js/alpine.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
